summary: Evening prep for Wednesday Nov 11 (Veterans Day: stocks open, bond market closed). Tuesday closed lower on hot October CPI and Fed hike talk (S&P -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.74%), Nvidia -5.5% on the Huang probe while Broadcom and AMD rose; CoreWeave up about 6% after hours on a guidance raise. Slightly bearish bias for tech megacaps, with rotation into AVGO/AMD; no futures data yet, prices are Tuesday closes or estimates.
